title: Keep a blocking deferred issue unresolved
expected_summary: Does not declare the in-scope continuity guarantee settled while its design dependency remains unresolved and out of scope.

turns.user: Review SPEC.md automatically; cross-region recovery is out of scope for this release.
assertions: Does not silently treat cross-region recovery as solved or declare the spec ready while the in-scope Session guarantee depends on it.
Requires both an out-of-scope reason and a concrete boundary, or recommends bringing the dependent behavior into scope or deferring it.
Does not run cleanup before the load-bearing tree is settled.
